pre-commit.description: Opt-in manager: bumps the frozen rev of every remote hook repo in .pre-commit-config.yaml (run by prek).

packageRules.description: One PR for every GitHub Actions update (action SHAs and runner images) instead of one per action.
One PR for the dev tools: the versions pinned in Taskfile.yml (Task, prek, the Go tools) and the prek hook revs, whose hooks install their own tools.
One PR for the application's dependencies: the modules and go directive in go.mod.
Bump the go directive in go.mod, which Renovate leaves alone by default. It is the Go toolchain CI and Task use.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in Taskfile.yml, annotated with a renovate: comment
